# Read dataset and summarize data for each CoupleID
## Batch 8 and 9
```{r}
## Read data
data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Combined_dataset_Batch89_filtered.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

## Convert into factor
data <- data  |> 
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.factor(CrossType)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(PetriNumber = as.factor(PetriNumber)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID = as.factor(CoupleID))

## Correct names of F1 and F2
data <- data |>
  dplyr::mutate(Male = dplyr::if_else(grepl("-", Male), dplyr::if_else(Batch==8, paste("F1", Male, sep="-"), paste("F2", Male, sep="-")), Male))|>
  dplyr::mutate(Female = dplyr::if_else(grepl("-", Female), dplyr::if_else(Batch==8, paste("F1", Female, sep="-"), paste("F2", Female, sep="-")), Female)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = paste( Female, Male, sep="x"))

## Provide a single name for individuals from reciprocal crosses (e.g. L6-Bal and Bal-L6 are all L6-Bal)
data <- data |>
  dplyr::mutate(Female2 = gsub("Bal-L6", "L6-Bal", Female))|>
  dplyr::mutate(Female2 = gsub("Trento-L6", "L6-Trento", Female2))|>
  dplyr::mutate(Male2 = gsub("Bal-L6", "L6-Bal", Male))|>
  dplyr::mutate(Male2 = gsub("Trento-L6", "L6-Trento", Male2)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType2 = paste( Female2, Male2, sep="x"))

##Summarize data for each CoupleID (1810 rows)
merged_data <- data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CoupleID, CrossType, Female, Male, CrossType2, Female2, Male2, Batch, Block, Year) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(sum_eggcount_corr = sum(EggCountCorr),
                   sum_larvacount = sum(LarvaeCount))

## Compute hatch rate for each CoupleID
merged_data <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(hatchrate = sum_larvacount / sum_eggcount_corr) 

#merged_data[merged_data$Female=="F1-L6-Trento"&merged_data$Male2=="Am"&merged_data$Batch==8,]
```

## Batch 1-7
```{r}
## Read data
data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Combined_dataset_filtered.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

## Convert as factor
data <- data  |> 
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.factor(CrossType)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(PetriNumber = as.factor(PetriNumber)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID = as.factor(CoupleID))

## Add fake columns
data <- data |>
  dplyr::mutate(Female2 = Female)|>
  dplyr::mutate(Male2 = Male)|>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType2 = CrossType)

##Summarize data for each CoupleID (1810 rows)
merged_data2 <- data |>
#  dplyr::group_by(CoupleID, CrossType, Female, Male, Batch, Block, Year) |>
    dplyr::group_by(CoupleID, CrossType, Female, Male, CrossType2, Female2, Male2, Batch, Block, Year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(sum_eggcount_corr = sum(EggCountCorr),
                   sum_larvacount = sum(LarvaeCount))

## Filter to keep only data for Bal, L6 and Trento
crosstype <- c("AmxAm", "BalxBal", "TrentoxTrento", "L6xL6", "AmxBal", "BalxAm", "AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "AmxL6", "L6xAm")
merged_data2 <- merged_data2 |>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType%in%crosstype)

## Compute hatch rate for each CoupleID
merged_data2 <- merged_data2 |>
  dplyr::mutate(hatchrate = sum_larvacount / sum_eggcount_corr)

## Merge the dataset from Bal, L6 and Trento
merged_data <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::ungroup()
merged_data2 <- merged_data2 |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

merged_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(merged_data, merged_data2)
```

# Plot distribution of hatch rate
## All
```{r}

data <- data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(hatch_rate = LarvaeCount / EggCountCorr)
data

dataPar6Bal <- data %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("L6|Bal", CrossType))

## Overall distribution in hatch rate (counts)
p <- data %>%
  #dplyr::filter(EggCountCorr>10)  %>%
  ggplot() + 
  geom_histogram(aes(hatch_rate))
p

## Overall distribution in hatch rate (frequency)
p <- data %>% 
  ggplot()  + 
  geom_histogram(aes(x=hatch_rate, y = after_stat(count / sum(count))), bins = 20) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  ylab("Frequency")
p
## Make plot with max 20 counts per class
p <- p + ggplot2::facet_wrap(~CrossType)
p   

#save bar plot
title_plot <- "Distribution_of_hatch_rate_F1_F2.pdf"
cowplot::save_plot(file = here::here("plots", title_plot),
                   p, base_height = 40/cm(1),
                   base_width = 100/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

# Fit all zero-inflated GLMM with merged data
## One dataset at a time
```{r}
## Example for one cross
AmBal <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "Bal"), data=merged_data)

AmTrento<- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "Trento"), data=merged_data)

AmPar6<- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "L6"), data=merged_data)

## F1
AmF1Bal<- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "F1-L6-Bal"), data=merged_data, female="Female", male="Male")

AmF1Trento<- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "F1-L6-Trento"), data=merged_data, female="Female2", male="Male2")

## F2
AmF2Bal <- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "F2-L6-Bal"), data=merged_data, female="Female2", male="Male2")

AmF2Trento<- fit_ZIBinomial(crosses=c("Europe", "Am", "F2-L6-Trento"), data=merged_data, female="Female2", male="Male2")
```

## All datasets together
```{r}
## List strains
europe <- unique(merged_data$Male[merged_data$Female=="Am"&merged_data$Male!="Am"])
europe <- europe[c(2, 3,7, 6, 4, 10, 8, 1, 5, 11, 9)]

#europe <- unique(merged_data$Male2[merged_data$Female=="Am"&merged_data$Male!="Am"])
#europe <- europe[c(2, 3, 5, 4, 6, 1, 7)]

## Dataframe with all the strains
crosses <- data.frame(continent=rep("Europe", length(europe)), uninf_strain = rep("Am", length(europe)), inf_strain= europe)

## Fit all models on all the crosses function
results <- apply(crosses, 1, fit_ZIBinomial, female="Female", male="Male", nbootsim=100)
#results <- apply(crosses, 1, fit_ZIBinomial, female="Female2", male="Male2")

## Extract the results from all models
crossnum <- 1:nrow(crosses)
##crossnum <- 1:10

confintp1 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp1"))

confintp2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp2"))

AICC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="modelaicc"))

CI <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintCI"))

## Export files
write.table(x = AICC, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "model_AICc_F1_F2.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = confintp1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp1_F1_F2.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = confintp2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_F1_F2.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = CI, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "CI_estimates_F1_F2.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Fit model for crosses
## Bal
```{r, eval=TRUE}

merged_data2 <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType, Female, Male, Batch, Year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(hatch_rate=sum_larvacount/sum_eggcount_corr )

## Compute proportion of eggs that hatch into larvae
merged_data$prop <- merged_data$sum_larvacount / merged_data$sum_eggcount_corr
  
## Subset the data with a single type of cross
strains <- c("L6", "Bal", "F1-L6-Bal", "F1-Bal-L6", "F2-L6-Bal", "F2-Bal-L6")
crosstype <- paste0("Amx", strains)
#dat <- merged_data[merged_data$CrossType%in%crosstype, ]
dat <- merged_data[merged_data$CrossType%in%crosstype&merged_data$Batch%in%c(8, 9), ]

## Variable to fit different variances for F2 vs. the other crosstypes
dat$vargroup <- as.factor(grepl("F2", dat$CrossType)*1)

## Variable for autosomal effect (L6: -1, Bal: +1, F1/F2: 0)
dat$alpha1 <- as.factor(dat$CrossType)
levels(dat$alpha1) <- c(1, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1)
dat$alpha1 <- as.numeric(as.character(dat$alpha1))

## Variable for dominance (L6/Bal: -1, F1: +1, F2: 0)
dat$dominance <- as.factor(dat$CrossType)
levels(dat$dominance) <- c(-1, 1, 1, 0, 0, -1)
dat$dominance <- as.numeric(as.character(dat$dominance))

## Variable for cytoplasm (L6 or Bal depending on the mother/grandmother)
dat$cyto <- as.factor(dat$CrossType)
levels(dat$cyto) <- c("Bal", "Bal", "L6", "Bal",  "L6", "L6")

## Variable for X effect (L6: -1, Bal: +1, F1: -1 (L6 mother) or +1 (Bal mother), F2: 0)
dat$X <- as.factor(dat$CrossType)
levels(dat$X) <- c(1, 1, -1, 0, 0, -1)
dat$X <- as.numeric(as.character(dat$X))

## Variable for maternal effect (L6: -1, Bal: +1, F1: -1 (L6 mother) or +1 (Bal mother), F2: 0)
dat$mother <- as.factor(dat$CrossType)
levels(dat$mother) <- c(1, 1, -1, 0, 0, -1)
dat$mother <- as.numeric(as.character(dat$mother))


## Variable for Y effect (L6: -1, Bal: +1, F1: -1 (L6 mother) or +1 (Bal mother), F2: 0)
dat$Y <- as.factor(dat$CrossType)
levels(dat$Y) <- c("Bal", "L6", "Bal", "L6",  "Bal", "L6")

## Fit saturated model
m0 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~  -1 + CrossType + (1| CoupleID) , data=dat, ziformula=~ -1 + CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m0)
glmmTMB::diagnose(m0)

## Cytoplasmic effects effects
m1 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ -1 + cyto + (1| CoupleID) , data=dat, ziformula=~  1 , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m1)
glmmTMB::diagnose(m1)

## Only autosomal effects
m2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + (1 | CoupleID) , data=dat, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m2)

## Autosomal and cytoplasmic effects
m3 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + cyto + (1| CoupleID) , data=dat, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m3)

## Only autosomal and dominance effects
m4 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + dominance + (1| CoupleID) , data=dat, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m4)

## Autosomal and cytoplasmic and dominance effects
m5 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + dominance + cyto + (1| CoupleID) , data=dat, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m5)

## Autosomal x cytoplasmic and dominance effects
m6 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1*cyto + dominance + (1| CoupleID) , data=dat, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m6)

## Autosomal + X + dominance effects
m7 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + X + dominance + (1| CoupleID) , data=dat, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m7)

## Autosomal + X + dominance effects + cyto (not present it)
m8 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + X + dominance+ cyto + (1| CoupleID) , data=dat, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m8)

#Exctract AICs
models <- list(
  m0 = m0,
  m1 = m1,
  m2 = m2,
  m3 = m3,
  m4 = m4,
  m5 = m5,
  m6 = m6,
  m7 = m7)

aic <- tibble::tibble(model = names(models), AIC = sapply(models, AIC)) |> dplyr::arrange(AIC)

write.table(x = aic, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "AICc_genetic_effect_F1_F2.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

## Only X effects (does not converge)
#m3 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ X + (1 | CoupleID) , data=dat, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
#summary(m3)
#glmmTMB::diagnose(m3)

## Only Y effects (does not converge)
#m4 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ -1 + Y + (1 | CoupleID) , data=dat, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
#summary(m4)
#glmmTMB::diagnose(m3)
## Different variance for F2
#m2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + (0+lme4::dummy(vargroup, "0")| CoupleID) + (0+lme4::dummy(vargroup, "1")| CoupleID) , data=dat, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)


MuMIn::model.sel(m0, m1, m2, m3, m4, m5, m6, m7, m8)

newdata <- expand.grid(alpha1 = c(-1, 0, 1), dominance = -1, sum_eggcount_corr=100)
newdata$prop_Bal <- (newdata$alpha1 + 1)/2

## Add CrossType otherwise the prediction does not work
newdata$CrossType <- "AmxBal"
newdata$pred.cond <- predict(m4, type="conditional", re.form=NA, newdata=newdata)

```

```{r, eval=TRUE}
summary(m4)

## Autosomal and cytoplasmic  and dominance effects
m5 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + dominance + cyto + (1| CoupleID) , data=dat, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m5)

## Autosomal x cytoplasmic and dominance effects
m6 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1*cyto + dominance + (1| CoupleID) , data=dat, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
 
summary(m6)

MuMIn::model.sel(m0, m1, m2, m3, m4, m5, m6)
```

# Plot CI data
## Load data
```{r, eval=TRUE}
## Read data
data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "CI_estimates_F1_F2.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

head(data)
data$infstrain <- gsub("F1-F1", "F1",data$infstrain)
data$infstrain <- gsub("F2-F2", "F2",data$infstrain)
```

## L6 / Bal
```{r, eval=TRUE}
## Expected lines means
expected <- data.frame(Cross=c("P1", "P2", "F1", "F2"), expected_CI = c(mean(data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="L6"]), mean(data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Bal"]), mean(data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Bal"|data$infstrain=="L6"]), mean(data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Bal"|data$infstrain=="L6"])))

## Observed line means
```

```{r, eval=TRUE}
newdata$pred.cond <- predict(m4, type="conditional", re.form=NA, newdata=newdata)
  dplyr::mutate(Strain=factor(Strain, levels=c("Bal","Par6","F1-Par6-Bal","F1-Bal-Par6","F2-Par6-Bal","F2-Bal-Par6")))
newdata$Strain <- "Bal"
newdata$pred.mortality <- 1- newdata$pred.cond

## Add CrossType otherwise the prediction does not work
newdata$CrossType <- "AmxBal"
newdata$pred.cond <- predict(m4, type="conditional", re.form=NA, newdata=newdata)


### To do list of strains
strain_replacements <- list(
  "L6" = "Par6"
)

change_name <- function (dat, strain_name_old, strain_name_new) {
  dat <- dat %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Strain = stringr::str_replace_all(Strain, strain_name_old, strain_name_new)
    )
}
for (old_strain in names(strain_replacements)) {
  new_strain <- strain_replacements[[old_strain]]
  dat <- change_name(dat, old_strain, new_strain)
}
dat <- dat |>
dplyr::distinct(Strain, .keep_all = TRUE)

## Overall distribution in hatch rate (frequency)

  ggplot(aes(x=prop_Bal, y=observed_mortality, color=Strain))  + 
  #geom_jitter(width = 0.005, size=5, height = 0) +
  geom_point(size=10) +
  geom_text(
    label=dat$Strain, 
    nudge_x = c(0, 0, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05), nudge_y = 0.02, 
    check_overlap = TRUE,
    size= 20
  ) + 
  geom_line(data = newdata, aes(x = prop_Bal, y = pred.mortality, color="black")) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Par6" = "violet",
      "Bal" = "#F8766D",

      "F1-Bal-Par6" = "#00C094",
      "F2-Par6-Bal" = "#53B400",
      "F2-Bal-Par6" = "#A58AFF"))+
  #geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1) +
  labs(x = "Proportion of Bal genes", y = "Embryo mortality") +   ggtitle("Embryo mortality in cross L6 / Bal") +
#  xlim(0, 1) +
#  ylim(0, 1) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold"), axis.text = element_text(size = 40),
axis.title=element_text(size=40, face="bold"), legend.position="none")

pBal
```

```{r, eval=TRUE}
observed <- data.frame(Strain= c(rep("L6", 1), rep("Bal", 1), rep("F1-L6-Bal", 1), rep("F1-Bal-L6", 1), rep("F2-L6-Bal", 1), rep("F2-Bal-L6", 1)), Cross=c(rep("P1", 1), rep("P2", 1), rep("F1", 2), rep("F2", 2)), observed_hatch_rate = c(data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="L6"][2], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Bal"][2],
ifelse(sum(data$infstrain=="F1-L6-Bal")==1, data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F1-L6-Bal"], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F1-L6-Bal"][2]),
ifelse(sum(data$infstrain=="F1-Bal-L6")==1, data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F1-Bal-L6"], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F1-Bal-L6"][2]),
ifelse(sum(data$infstrain=="F2-L6-Bal")==1, data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F2-L6-Bal"], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F2-L6-Bal"][2]),
ifelse(sum(data$infstrain=="F2-Bal-L6")==1, data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F2-Bal-L6"], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F2-Bal-L6"][2])))

newdata <- expand.grid(alpha1 = c(1, 0, -1), dominance = -1, sum_eggcount_corr=100)

## Add CrossType otherwise the prediction does not work
newdata$CrossType <- "AmxBal"
newdata$prop_Par6 <- c(0, 0.5, 1)
newdata$pred.cond <- predict(m4, type="conditional", re.form=NA, newdata=newdata)

dat <- dplyr::left_join(observed, expected, by="Cross") |>

newdata$pred.cond <- predict(m4, type="conditional", re.form=NA, newdata=newdata) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Strain=factor(Strain, levels=c("Par6","Bal","F1-Par6-Bal","F1-Bal-Par6","F2-Par6-Bal","F2-Bal-Par6")))
newdata$Strain <- "Bal"
newdata$pred.hatch <- newdata$pred.cond

  "L6" = "Par6"
)

  dat <- dat %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Strain = stringr::str_replace_all(Strain, strain_name_old, strain_name_new)
    )
}
for (old_strain in names(strain_replacements)) {
  new_strain <- strain_replacements[[old_strain]]
  dat <- change_name(dat, old_strain, new_strain)
}
dat <- dat |>
dplyr::distinct(Strain, .keep_all = TRUE)

## Overall distribution in hatch rate (frequency)

  ggplot(aes(x=prop_Par6, y=observed_hatch_rate, color=Strain))  +

  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(

pBal
```
